SessionStart.command: git checkout main 2>$null; git branch -D beta 2>$null; git checkout -b beta main

PreToolUse.command: $branch = git branch --show-current 2>$null; if ($branch -ne 'beta') { git checkout beta 2>$null; Write-Host '[hook] switched to beta' }

PostToolUse.command: $changes = git status --porcelain 2>$null; if ($changes) { git add -A; git commit -m "chore(auto): agent modification" }
